Dehydrated Rosemary Leaves Supplier — Dehydrated Rosemary Leaves for Food Manufacturing

Tradenest Naturals is a dependable dehydrated rosemary leaves supplier from India. We supply clean, aromatic rosemary leaves for food manufacturers, seasoning companies, restaurants, exporters, and private label brands. Our product supports bulk production, retail packing, and custom ingredient programs. Rosemary leaves provide a distinctive herbal aroma and a warm, pine-like flavor. Dehydration helps reduce moisture while preserving the practical culinary value of the herb. As a result, buyers can store, transport, and use the product more easily than fresh rosemary. We offer bulk dehydrated rosemary leaves in practical commercial specifications. Our team can also review particle size, packaging, labeling, and supply requirements. Therefore, customers receive a product solution that fits their application and market.

Product Overview

Our dehydrated rosemary leaves come from carefully selected rosemary foliage. We clean and process the leaves under controlled food-processing conditions. Next, we remove foreign matter and sieve the dried material according to the agreed specification. The finished product works well in dry seasoning systems and savory recipes. It can also support foodservice and industrial applications. In addition, buyers may choose standard bulk supply or private label packaging through Tradenest Naturals.
  • Natural rosemary leaf ingredient for commercial food use
  • Suitable for seasoning, bakery, sauce, and ready-meal applications
  • Available in whole leaf, cut leaf, and customized particle sizes
  • Produced for wholesale, export, OEM, and private label programs
  • Supplied with batch identification and agreed product documentation

Manufacturing and Processing

We begin with raw material inspection and supplier verification. Then, our processing team removes visible impurities and unsuitable material. Controlled dehydration reduces moisture and supports better storage stability. After drying, we inspect the leaves for color, aroma, and physical condition. We then cut or sieve the leaves to meet the buyer’s required size. Finally, we pack the product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Our process includes cleaning, dehydration, sorting, cutting, sieving, metal-control practices, packing, and batch traceability. However, the exact process can vary according to the customer specification. We confirm all commercial details before production.

Typical Technical Specifications

Standard commercial specifications provide a useful starting point for quotations. Buyers may request a different mesh, moisture limit, or purity requirement. We confirm the final values in the product specification and sales documents.
  • Form: Dried rosemary leaves
  • Particle options: Whole leaf, cut leaf, coarse, or fine sifted material
  • Typical mesh: 10–20 mesh for cut leaf; 40–60 mesh for fine material
  • Typical moisture: Maximum 8%
  • Typical purity: Minimum 98%
  • Color: Green to greyish green, depending on crop and processing
  • Flavor: Herbal, pine-like, woody, and mildly peppery
  • Additives: No added colors, preservatives, or fillers in the standard product
Actual values depend on the selected grade and agreed quality plan. We can provide a sample for review before a larger purchase. In addition, customers may request applicable test reports or quality documents based on the destination market and order requirements.

Quality and Food Safety

Tradenest Naturals follows documented food-processing practices. We focus on raw material control, moisture management, sanitation, inspection, and batch traceability. These controls help support consistent quality across repeat orders. We do not claim a certification unless it applies to the specific product and order. Instead, we review the buyer’s required standards before quotation. Customers can discuss requirements such as allergen information, microbiological testing, pesticide documentation, labeling rules, and destination-country compliance. Every export order receives a documented review. This review covers product grade, packaging, labeling, shipping terms, and required commercial paperwork. As a result, the buyer and supplier share a clear supply plan before dispatch.

Applications

Dehydrated rosemary leaves add recognizable herbal character to many food products. They work especially well where manufacturers need convenient handling and stable storage. The leaves can enter a recipe directly or support a blended seasoning system.
  • Herb and spice blends
  • Pizza, pasta, and Italian seasoning
  • Roasted vegetables and potato products
  • Soups, sauces, gravies, and marinades
  • Ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat meals
  • Bakery products, crackers, and savory snacks
  • Meat, poultry, seafood, and plant-based products
  • Foodservice packs for restaurants and catering businesses
For example, a seasoning manufacturer may combine rosemary with garlic, onion, oregano, basil, and pepper. A prepared-food producer may use cut rosemary in marinades or oven-ready meals. Therefore, the ingredient supports both simple recipes and complex seasoning systems.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack the product in food-grade materials that resist moisture and help protect aroma. Standard options include inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, and bulk export bags. We also support custom printed and private label packaging. The typical shelf life is 24 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. The final shelf life depends on the packaging format, storage conditions, and approved product specification.
  • 1 kg and 5 kg packs for foodservice and smaller manufacturers
  • 10 kg and 25 kg packs for wholesale buyers
  • Bulk bags for large industrial orders
  • Custom retail packs for private label programs
  • Export-grade secondary packaging for international transport
Each pack can include product name, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage instructions, and regulatory details. In addition, we can review destination-market labeling needs before printing.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Export Supply

The minimum order quantity depends on product availability, leaf grade, packaging format, and customization. A typical starting MOQ for standard bulk supply is 100 kg. Private label orders and custom formulations may require a higher MOQ. Lead time usually ranges from 2 to 4 weeks after specification approval, payment terms, and packaging confirmation. However, the schedule may change during peak seasons or for custom printed packaging. We confirm the production and dispatch plan with every quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your required quantity, destination country, preferred particle size, packaging format, and target application. Also share any quality, labeling, or certification requirements. Our team will then review the request and provide the most suitable commercial proposal.

Why Buy from Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals operates as a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, exporter, and food ingredient development partner. We support both established importers and growing brands. Our wider capabilities include grinding, sieving, blending, seasoning development, custom packing, and OEM manufacturing. Moreover, our ingredient network helps us manage repeat supply programs. We focus on practical specifications, transparent communication, and dependable documentation. In short, we help buyers reduce sourcing complexity while maintaining product consistency.
  • Flexible supply for wholesale and export customers
  • Multiple particle sizes and packaging formats
  • Support for private label and OEM requirements
  • Batch-level product and packing traceability
  • Technical discussion before production
  • Competitive pricing for repeat and bulk orders

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The typical MOQ starts at 100 kg for standard bulk supply. We confirm the final MOQ after reviewing grade, packaging, and customization requirements.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Applicable documents depend on the product, destination, and order terms. We can discuss food safety practices, specifications, testing, allergen information, and import requirements. We provide only documents that apply to the confirmed order.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available?

We offer 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, 25 kg, bulk, retail, private label, and export packaging options. The typical shelf life is 24 months in sealed, moisture-protected packaging.

What are the typical specifications?

Typical material has 98% minimum purity, up to 8% moisture, and 10–20 mesh cut leaf. Fine grades may use 40–60 mesh. We confirm the final specification before production.

How can I request a sample or quote?

Contact Tradenest Naturals with your quantity, destination, application, mesh preference, and packaging needs. We will review the request and respond with sample or quotation details.

Standards & references

  • APEDA — India’s agri & processed food export authority
  • FSSAI — Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
